content: W3C WAI APG Developing a Keyboard Interface: (1) Persistence of focus - when DOM removal leaves nothing focused, browsers drop focus to body = loss of orientation; managed focus after view swaps is the remedy (canonical basis for h1-focus-on-route-swap). (2) tabindex=-1 removes element from tab sequence but stays focusable via element.focus() - the heading pattern. (3) Do not set initial focus on page load except for single-primary-function pages - canonical basis for no-focus-on-cold-load (D14-03). (4) Focus moves scroll the element into view (roving tabindex note).
